name: Kangan Institute Education Support Scholarship
summary: A fee waiver or reduction for Kangan and Bendigo TAFE students facing financial or personal disadvantage.
key: Can provide local students with a waiver or a reduction of their course fees.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or eligible visa holder
Financial or personal disadvantage such as low income, disability or interrupted study
how: Complete the online application with supporting documents before the course start date
Under 18s need parent or guardian consent
catches: Applications open all year; outcome within two weeks
Does not cover stationery or computer equipment

evidence.quote: can provide local students with a waiver or a reduction of their course fees.
Applications are open throughout the year.
